notes.notes:
Come and Join the Devs for a few games of Prank Call.
We are currently  running a sale to boost player numbers, looking forward to seeing you in game.

notes.title: 100 New Words!
notes.notes:
We've just doubled the number of words in the game, there are now 200 words in total.
Also fixed the First Win achievement (it will unlock on your next win if you don't already have it)

Please remember to leave a review if you haven't already, it really helps with getting the word out about the game, and the more players there is the better experience it is.
